## Pneumonia: A Medical Overview :

Pneumonia is a respiratory infection that inflames the air sacs in the lungs (alveoli). It can be caused by bacteria, viruses, or fungi. Symptoms include coughing, fever, and difficulty breathing, and it can be life-threatening if not diagnosed and treated promptly.  
 LIVE LINK - 

Challenges in Diagnosis:

 Diagnosing pneumonia through chest X-rays can be subjective and prone to human error.
 Radiologists must interpret numerous images daily, increasing the risk of oversight in busy clinical environments.
 Variations in imaging quality and the presentation of pneumonia in X-rays make diagnosis more complex
